name: calo
note: CMS Phase-2 barrel and forward calorimeters (Fireworks/EventExport preset calo): ECAL barrel, HCAL barrel (HB), outer (HO) and forward (HF) rechits, drawn as eta-phi towers from their front face (x y z is the cell's front-face centre). Phase 2 has no ECAL endcap, preshower or HCAL endcap (HGCal replaces them): EcalHits are all EB, HBHEHits all HB. Tower sizes are the nominal bins (EB 0.0174, HB and HO 0.087; HF approximated as 0.175 x 0.087, its rings vary) until the exporter writes dEta dPhi thickness per hit. Depth: EB and HO show energy as length (one layer each), HB and HF a geometric depth (several depths or fibre lengths per tower). Cuts per subdetector, as the noise levels differ (measured on the ttbar samples, hits above the default: EB 0.5 GeV 201 / 813 per event at 0PU / PU200, HB 1 GeV, HF 3 GeV). HO and HF start hidden; HF (r 12-130 cm, |z| 1115-1280 cm) is not drawn in the front view, where it would sit inside the barrel. Domain Calo: the barrel region, front view.
